title: Maharashtra RTI Online citizen user manual
issuer: General Administration Department, Government of Maharashtra and National Informatics Centre
excerpt: The manual records the 150-word request field, PDF attachments up to 1 MB, BPL certificate upload, ten-rupee application fee, twenty-rupee first-appeal fee, online payment methods and routing through nodal officers.
notes: Captured as inert data, size-capped, PDF-signature checked, hashed and Defender-scanned. Demonstration applicant data is not reproduced in the repository. References to RTI Rules, 2012 require legal review in the Maharashtra context.

technical.notes: Portal limits, fees, evidence and payment workflow verified.

legalRti.notes: Reconcile its 2012-rules wording with the Maharashtra amendment chain.
